rawCommits.subject: feat(skills): edit existing user-authored skills (#66)
rawCommits.body:
* feat(skills): edit existing user-authored skills

Add `PUT /api/harness/skills/mine/{name}` to rewrite a user-created
skill's SKILL.md (frontmatter + body). Guards: 404 when the skill is
missing, 403 when it isn't user-created, 400 on an invalid name.
Mirrors the create flow's shared frontmatter renderer and its
harness-first / write-last ordering so the marker-bearing file wins.

Frontend: wire an "Edit skill" action in SkillsTab into a repurposed
editor modal that pre-fills from getSkill, keeps the name read-only,
and round-trips allowed_tools/model/context so an edit doesn't drop
fields the UI doesn't surface.

Adds backend handler tests (rewrite+reregister, 404, 403, 400) and
frontend tests for the updateMySkill client and the edit wiring.

* fix(skills): fail loud when skill-edit re-register fails

The skill-edit re-register POST to the harness is what reloads the
in-memory skill registry, and that registry — not the on-disk file — is
what agents resolve a skill's content from. It was fire-and-forget, so a
failed POST left the registry serving the old body while the handler
still rewrote SKILL.md and returned 200: a silent stale-serve behind a
success response.

Make the edit path check the harness response (new post_json_ok gateway
helper) and return 502 before writing the file, so a failed re-register
leaves disk and the live registry consistent (both pre-edit) instead of
diverging. Adds a failing-harness mock and a test asserting 502 + the
on-disk file is untouched.

rawCommits.subject: ci(evals): speed up functional smoke setup
fix(billing): retry transient credit pre-flight failures
rawCommits.body:
require_credits called the billing client once with no retry, so a single
transport blip or 5xx (e.g. a billing-server cold start) failed the user's
chat turn outright with a 502. Retry transient failures (transport errors
and 5xx) with short backoffs; definitive answers (insufficient credits,
auth/account errors) return immediately without retry, so broke users pay
no latency penalty. Cache only positive results, since the credit cache is
read solely as a positive has-credits short-circuit. Adds tests for retry
recovery, error-surfaced-without-caching after exhaustion, and
no-retry-on-insufficient-credits.

rendered.title: Editable skills, sturdier chat turns, and faster eval CI
rendered.intro: Today's nightly brings a long-requested skill editing flow for user-authored skills, tightens reliability around billing pre-flight and observability probes, trims eval CI setup time, and lands a careful fix for multiline prompts in chat.

entries.title: Editable user skills, retry-safe billing, and tightened eval probes
entries.summary: A morning-to-afternoon push shipped in-place editing for user-authored skills, made the credit pre-flight resilient to transient billing failures, hardened multi-agent observability probes, and slimmed down the functional smoke setup in CI.

items.text: User-authored skills can now be edited in place via a new PUT /api/harness/skills/mine/{name} endpoint and a repurposed editor modal in the Agents SkillsTab that pre-fills from getSkill, locks the name, and round-trips allowed_tools/model/context. The edit path is harness-first: if the harness re-register fails, the server returns 502 and leaves SKILL.md untouched so disk and the live registry never diverge behind a silent 200.

Credit pre-flight (require_credits) now retries transient billing failures — transport errors and 5xx, e.g. a billing-server cold start — with short backoffs instead of failing a chat turn with a 502 on the first blip. Definitive answers like insufficient credits or auth errors still return immediately, and only positive results are cached so a transient failure can't linger.

Multi-agent status probes now require persisted child-thread evidence (sessionId, childRunId, sessionSubagentThreadMatchesChild, sessionSubagentCompleted) for the project-bound subagent roundtrip, replacing the looser context-utilization signal so a passing probe actually proves the session exposed the child thread.

The aura-evals workflow now runs Playwright-bearing jobs inside the official Playwright container with browser install skipped, adds explicit per-job timeouts and in-progress cancellation for the same PR/ref, and the shared CI runner prints per-command elapsed time and retry duration for easier triage.

entries.title: Enter-to-send no longer eats fast multiline pastes in chat
entries.summary: Late-night fix to the chat input bar adds a short grace window after Enter so a quickly-arriving newline burst is treated as multiline input rather than an accidental submit.

items.text: InputBarShell now defers Enter submission by a 100ms grace period: if more text arrives before the timer fires, the keystroke is reinterpreted as a newline and the buffered value is stitched back together (e.g. "Line one" + "Line two" becomes "Line one\nLine two") instead of submitting a half-written prompt. Clicking Send during the grace window still submits exactly once.

highlights: Edit your own skills from the Agents panel
Chat turns survive transient billing blips
Rapid multiline prompts no longer get truncated
Eval CI runs leaner and with shared timing visibility
